purpose: Classify every GitHub Actions workflow by its review and operating role. This registry documents policy; branch protection remains the source of truth for required checks.

policy_classes.required: Intended to gate pull requests or protected pushes when its branch and path filters match.
policy_classes.scheduled: Runs on a schedule for health, regression, or service-level monitoring; failures remain visible and tracked.
policy_classes.informational: Runs manually or for deployment reporting and is not intended to be a merge gate.
